messages.subject: more mailing lists?
parts:
I'm now seeing the wisdom of theano's layout

http://deeplearning.net/software/theano/#community

Register to theano-announce if you want to be kept informed on
important change on theano(low volume).

Register and post to theano-users if you want to talk to all Theano
users.

Register and post to theano-dev if you want to talk to the developers.

Register to theano-github if you want to receive an email for all
changes to the GitHub repository.

Register to theano-buildbot if you want to receive our daily buildbot
email.

Ask/view questions/answers at metaoptimize/qa/tags/theano (itï¿½s like
stack overflow for machine learning)

We try to stay organized with Theanoï¿½s Trac

Come visit us in Montreal! Most of the developers are students in the
LISA group at the University of Montreal.

That'd be our existing two groups

stan-users
stan-dev

and two more:

stan-announce
stan-buildbot

I have a feeling most of the stan-users registrees might be more
likely candidates for stan-announce.

Our equiv of "Theano's Trac" would be our issue tracker, and we
could even invite folks to visit us at Columbia!

I'm not sure about metaoptimize -- I'd almost rather just
use stackoverflow itself. But we could suggest a tag for several
of these setups. The problem is that I don't want to have to
monitor several locations for questions.

- Bob
